title: Five Discourses on Not Examining Form, Etc.
html:
• Saṁyutta Nikāya 33.41–45 Linked Discourses 33.41–45
  • 1. Vacchagottavagga 1. With Vacchagotta

Rūpaasamapekkhaṇādisuttapañcaka Five Discourses on Not Examining Form, Etc.

Sāvatthinidānaṁ. At Sāvatthī.

“Rūpe kho, vaccha, asamapekkhaṇā …pe… viññāṇe kho, vaccha, asamapekkhaṇā …pe…. “Vaccha, it is because of not examining form …” Pañcacattālīsamaṁ.
